$dbPing.description: Returns the database round trip in ms (works on every database type, MongoDB included)

$deleteRecords.description: Deletes the variables matching your inputs. At least one input is required (use $wipeDB to delete everything). Name and value accept % (any text) and _ (one character)

name.description: The variable name; % matches any text, _ one character.

id.description: The ID of the user, guild, channel, or any other type.

value.description: The value; % matches any text, _ one character.

guild ID.description: The guild to which the member, channel, or role belongs (also a guild the bot left).

$getDB.description: Returns every stored variable as JSON

$searchDB.description: Returns the variables matching your inputs as JSON. Name and value accept % (any text) and _ (one character)

name.description: The variable name; % matches any text, _ one character.

id.description: The ID of the user, guild, channel, or any other type.

value.description: The value; % matches any text, _ one character.

guild ID.description: The guild to which the member, channel, or role belongs.

$wipeDB.description: Deletes every variable and every cooldown in the database

$channelLeaderboard.description: Creates a leaderboard specific to channels based on a variable.

name.description: The name of the variable used to create the leaderboard.

guild ID.description: The guild ID of the channels, defaults to the guild of the command.

sort type.description: The sorting order for the leaderboard, either ascending (asc) or descending (desc, the default).

max.description: The maximum number of entries per page, defaults to 10.

separator.description: The separator between rows, defaults to a new line.

envPosition.description: The variable name for $env to get the position with $env[<name>].

code.description: Code executed for each row. Remember to use $return, otherwise it will not return anything.

$deleteChannelVar.description: Removes a value from a variable associated with a channel (also works for a deleted channel)

channel ID.description: The channel ID, defaults to the channel of the command

$getChannelLeaderboardID.description: Returns the channel at a position of a channel leaderboard

sort type.description: The sort order for the leaderboard, either ascending (asc) or descending (desc, the default)

position.description: The position of the channel to find, starting at 1

guild ID.description: The guild ID of the channels, defaults to the guild of the command

$getChannelLeaderboardLength.description: Returns the number of pages of a channel leaderboard (channels with a number value)

name.description: The name of the variable to query

guild ID.description: The guild ID of the channels, defaults to the guild of the command

length.description: The number of channels per page, defaults to 1 (the number of channels)

decimals.description: Specify whether to return decimals for more precise results (default: false)

$getChannelLeaderboardValue.description: Fetches the position of a channel in the leaderboard of a variable, or 0 when the channel is not on it

name.description: The name of the variable to query

sort type.description: The sort order for the leaderboard, either ascending (asc) or descending (desc, the default)

channel ID.description: The channel ID, defaults to the channel of the command

$getChannelVar.description: Retrieves the value of a variable associated with a channel

name.description: The name of the variable to query

channel ID.description: The channel ID, defaults to the channel of the command

default.description: The value to return when the variable was never set

$setChannelVar.description: Assigns a value to a variable associated with a channel

name.description: The name of the variable to set the value in

channel ID.description: The channel ID, defaults to the channel of the command

$dbChannelCooldown.description: Starts a channel cooldown stored in the database, or, while it is running, sends the code and stops the command ($env[time] holds the ms left)

name.description: The name of the cooldown, e.g. the command name

code.description: The code to send while the cooldown is running; $env[time] holds the ms left

channel ID.description: The channel ID, defaults to the channel of the command

$dbDeleteChannelCooldown.description: Ends a channel cooldown started with $dbChannelCooldown

$data.description: Retrieves data of the variable created or deleted in a variableCreate or variableDelete event (the new data in variableUpdate). Returns nothing outside these events

$newData.description: Retrieves the new data of the variable in a variableUpdate event (the created data in variableCreate). Returns nothing outside these events

$oldData.description: Retrieves the old data of the variable in a variableUpdate event (the deleted data in variableDelete). Returns nothing outside these events

name.description: The name of the variable to remove
